acceptance: A prompt shows once, its media above its text and its file mentions inline, with its delivery state (queued, delivery unknown, not sent) readable in place; admission, the native echo and completion keep that one prompt with no state line; a partial reply says only part is shown without claiming a failure; a finished turn shows one muted Worked for line.

The live tail shows one status: Preparing the Agent or Starting turn while a submission prepares, Thinking while a running turn has nothing newer, Working around tool activity, nothing while an answer streams; after five seconds it adds the active elapsed time, which excludes approval waits; a running reasoning summary stays behind the status; a connection state replaces the status and goes once recovered.

Scrolling toward the start releases following (past the list's one-pixel bottom tolerance), so new rows leave the view where it is and Jump to latest appears; following resumes only at the bottom or on Jump to latest.

Agent Markdown parses task lists, nested lists, strikethrough and rules; raw HTML stays text, an unsafe link is no link and only https links navigate (through the host), an image shows only its alt text; a mermaid fence is drawn as a diagram by the render service.

reason: Agent Markdown in the native transcript has no footnotes, no bare-URL autolinks (only <url> and [text](url)), no table column alignment (`:---:`) and no lang attribute for locale-aware reading typography; tables, task lists, nested lists, strikethrough and rules do parse.

TS lets features register rich Markdown blocks by fence language and guards external navigation behind an optional host capability. The native transcript draws only its built-in mermaid block and always has the host's link opener, so there is no registry or absent capability to test.
